decisions.question: q-75735

authoring.question: q-75735
authoring.value:
The eigenvector $u=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0\end{aligned}]$ corresponds to the eigenvalue $\lambda =\frac{1}{2}.$ So, 

$$
\begin{aligned}Au & =\frac{1}{2}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, we have the following picture:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14056271/assets/c272ff1454ac4ab9825e312f563c9bca08ac2800faa0e95ab45e8a5e827369da.png)
